prompt: Find 5 vegetarian restaurants in Koramangala, Bengaluru, with ratings, addresses and Maps links.
response_text:
# Top Vegetarian Dining in Koramangala

Koramangala hosts a diverse selection of purely vegetarian dining spots, ranging from traditional South Indian tiffin centers to North Indian village-style thalis and modern Pan-Asian fine dining.

# Featured Vegetarian Restaurants in Koramangala

| Restaurant | Cuisine | Google Rating | Known For | Cost for Two |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gramin** | North Indian & Rajasthani | 4.3 / 5 | Homestyle rotis, Bhindi Anardana, Dal Afghani | ₹800 |
| **Sree Krishna Kafe** | Tamil Nadu South Indian | 4.2 / 5 | Traditional meals, crispy roast dosas, filter coffee | ₹350 |
| **Tuk Tuk Thai** | Pure Veg Pan-Asian & Thai | 4.4 / 5 | Thai green curry, dim sums, lotus stem crisps | ₹1,500 |
| **Sendhoor Coffee** | Quick-service South Indian | 4.4 / 5 | Ghee podi idli, vada, authentic filter coffee | ₹200 |
| **Sukh Sagar** | Multi-cuisine Vegetarian | 4.0 / 5 | Pav bhaji, dosas, seasonal juices, North Indian dishes | ₹700 |

---

### Option 1: Gramin | Homestyle North Indian and Rajasthani dishes | Rating: 4.3 / 5
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Address**: Ground Floor, 139/140, Raheja Arcade, Ganapathi Temple Road, 7th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095
- **Highlights**: Village-themed rustic interiors serving unpretentious, mildly spiced North Indian specialties and hearty lunch thalis.
Action: [Button: View on Google Maps] https://maps.google.com/?q=Gramin+Raheja+Arcade+Koramangala+Bengaluru

### Option 2: Sree Krishna Kafe | Authentic Tamil-style South Indian fare | Rating: 4.2 / 5
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Address**: 143, 60 Feet Road, KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095
- **Highlights**: Popular for quick, pocket-friendly breakfasts and homestyle Tamil Nadu meals served with non-sweet sambar and rasam.
Action: [Button: View on Google Maps] https://maps.google.com/?q=Sree+Krishna+Kafe+Koramangala+Bengaluru

### Option 3: Tuk Tuk Thai | 100% pure vegetarian Asian & Thai dining | Rating: 4.4 / 5
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
- **Address**: 17th Main Road, KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095
- **Highlights**: Rare all-vegetarian Asian dining setup offering bao buns, sushi, Tom Yum soup, and authentic Thai curries.
Action: [Button: View on Google Maps] https://maps.google.com/?q=Tuk+Tuk+Thai+Koramangala+Bengaluru

### Option 4: Sendhoor Coffee | Fast, budget-friendly South Indian tiffins | Rating: 4.4 / 5
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Address**: No. 100, Koundinya, 18th Main Road, KHB Colony, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095
- **Highlights**: Standing-room tiffin joint famous for quick service, piping hot ghee thatte idlis, crunchy vadas, and filter coffee.
Action: [Button: View on Google Maps] https://maps.google.com/?q=Sendhoor+Coffee+6th+Block+Koramangala+Bengaluru

### Option 5: Sukh Sagar | Veteran pure veg multi-cuisine restaurant | Rating: 4.0 / 5
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Address**: 100 Feet Road, KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095
- **Highlights**: Long-standing family favorite known for quick street snacks, Mumbai-style pav bhaji, Indo-Chinese, and fresh fruit juices.
Action: [Button: View on Google Maps] https://maps.google.com/?q=Sukh+Sagar+100+Feet+Rd+Koramangala+Bengaluru

# Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Explore Koramangala Veg on Maps] https://maps.google.com/?q=pure+veg+restaurants+in+Koramangala+Bengaluru
Action: [Button: Browse Food Outlets] https://www.swiggy.com/city/bangalore/koramangala-restaurants

# Sources
- Tuk Tuk Thai Koramangala Listing: https://wanderlog.com/
- Gramin Restaurant Details: https://magicpin.in/
- Sree Krishna Kafe Profile: https://www.swiggy.com/
